Lemma
[Connectedness of distance circles] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0113, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0114 1. ch29:29.25\group Backward Geometry

There is $\varepsilon >0$ such that, in a positively curved two-sphere, if an $\varepsilon $-neck separates a point $p$ from one end, then the first distance circle from $p$ meeting the neck is connected.
